headers.If-Match: quoted current warranty case version; stale value returns 412 STALE_VERSION
headers.Idempotency-Key: original P09 key; keep unchanged for retry
headers.X-Request-ID: original UUID; keep unchanged for retry and receipt correlation

query.warehouse_id: optional assertion; must match confirmed owner warehouse when supplied

body.receiver: required string, max 200; persisted encrypted in warranty_handovers.receiver_ciphertext
body.handover_date: required local calendar date YYYY-MM-DD entered by user; persisted separately
body.note: required string; persisted encrypted in warranty_handovers.note_ciphertext and copied only to RETURN warranty_event.note

forbidden: Do not concatenate receiver/date/checkbox into note.
Do not use server returned_at as handover_date.
Do not submit structured handover fields for a non-RETURNED update.

guards.warehouse: persisted warranty_case_warehouse_owners row, active warehouse, current confirmed session warehouse
guards.case: case exists, owner ACL passes, current case version matches If-Match, transition matrix allows COMPLETED -> RETURNED
guards.component_issues: all linked component_issue_documents for the case must belong to owner warehouse and have status POSTED; no linked documents is allowed

columns.warranty_case_id: UUID FK to canonical warranty case

data.handover.receiver: full only with warranty.pii.view, otherwise masked
data.handover.note: full only with warranty.pii.view, otherwise null

retry.same_key_same_request_id_same_body: Idempotent replay of the original response; no second version/event/handover row
retry.unknown_or_timeout: reconcile the original P09 request; do not create a compensating return

required: same-key retry evidence with stable X-Request-ID
